answer: One practical defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: an agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can vouch for others, so creating many fake identities multiplies the capital at risk. A public mirror of attestations lets anyone audit who vouched for whom, making duplicate patterns visible. Reputation then accrues slowly, like saffron harvested a pinch at a time, while a summit review of the highest-stake agents can flag clusters for investigation. Sybil operators must pay real money per identity and risk losing it, which caps how many fakes they can sustain.
